# Known CI flakes, read by scripts/ci-wait. A failed job counts as a known
# flake when every failing test in its log matches an entry below, or, for a
# job that died without reporting a failing test, when its whole log does.
#
# Format: `<name> <pattern>`, one per line. The name has no spaces; the
# pattern is the rest of the line, an extended regex (grep -E). Before
# matching, timestamps, `##[error]` prefixes and colour codes are stripped
# and the lines of each failing test (or of the whole log) are joined with
# spaces, so `.*` can span lines.
#
# Comment every entry: what it is and why it is not the change's fault.
# Mark entries waiting on a fix TEMPORARY and remove them when it lands.
# Flaky means broken (CODING_STANDARDS.md): an entry here is a stopgap that
# saves a CI round, not a reason to stop looking for the cause.

# The Erlang JIT crashing on the runner: mix test aborts with exit 134 after
# an asmjit assertion in jitallocator.cpp, unrelated to the code under test.
beam-jit-crash \[asmjit\] Assertion failed at asmjit/core/jitallocator\.cpp.*exit code 134

# A LiveView test (usually BrandoAdmin.ChromeSocketTokensTest) calls the
# Presence shard while the shard's database checkout belongs to another
# test's sandbox owner that has just exited, so the call dies with
# "owner #PID<…> exited".
presence-shard-owner-exited Presence_shard[0-9]+.*owner #PID<[0-9.]+> exited

# TEMPORARY: a race in the test, being fixed separately. Remove this entry
# when the fix is merged.
edit-session-overlapping-saves of two overlapping saves the second can be retried.*\(BrandoAdmin\.EditSessionSavesTest\)
